text:
Hello,

This is the third time I'm writing about the same thing and I still have nothing to show my accountant. I ordered a Contoso Vela Mini and I need a proper VAT invoice for it, not the order confirmation you keep resending. My company cannot book the expense without a receipt that shows the tax breakdown. Please just send me the invoice as a PDF and stop bouncing me around.

Mark Heller
我的AuraBook 14屏幕裂了。昨天合着盖子放在包里，上面压了几本书，拿出来一开就发现左上角一道裂纹，开机后那块区域显示不出来。现在想问一下换屏怎么弄，大概多少钱。

您好，

我的AuraBook Pro 16每次从睡眠唤醒后屏幕都会闪一下然后黑屏一秒钟再恢复，我今天下午三点要用它给客户做方案演示，希望能尽快帮我看看怎么处理。

谢谢，
周婷
哈喽，请问一下AuraBook Pro 16的电池续航比我刚拿到手的时候差了好多，以前能用七八个小时现在三个多小时就没电了，这个正常吗？
Hi, I need my Contoso account and everything you've collected from my Titan G7 deleted, and under GDPR you have 30 days to do it so please confirm this is actually being handled.
在吗？我的Titan G7上那个Contoso Vantage打开就闪退，好不容易进去了点登录又一直转圈，最后提示登录失败。我驱动都是靠它更新的，现在什么都做不了，真的很着急，你知道怎么弄吗？

My Titan G7 slid off my desk this morning and one of the corners is dented in now, plus there's a crack running along the bottom edge of the case. It still turns on but I'm really worried about what's going on inside. What should I do, can this be repaired?

Hey, hoping you can point me in the right direction. I installed the BIOS update that popped up on my Nimbus 2-in-1 last night, it went through the whole flashing process and then restarted, and since then it won't boot at all. When I press the power button the keyboard backlight comes on for a second and the fan spins up, but the screen stays completely black and nothing else happens. I've tried holding power down for a good thirty seconds and unplugging everything, no change. Is there a known recovery procedure for this, or do I need to send it in?

您好，

我的Contoso AuraBook Pro 16这两天一开机就弹出硬盘可能即将损坏的警告，随便打开一个文档都要卡半分钟，文件我已经全部拷到移动硬盘上了，但今天晚上我还得用这台电脑给客户做方案演示，麻烦直接告诉我现在怎么处理。

周立

Hi there,

I'm hoping someone can put my mind at ease. For the last few days, every time I turn on my Contoso Vela Mini, a dark screen comes up first saying something about a firmware error, and it just sits there for a few seconds. Then, without me doing anything, it moves on and Windows loads like nothing happened, and the laptop seems to run fine after that. It's really unsettling to see that screen every single morning and I keep worrying that one day it just won't continue past it. Could you tell me what this means and what I should do about it?

Thanks so much,
Priya

Yeah, hi, so, um, it's nothing dramatic, but my Contoso AuraBook 14 has started showing a firmware error screen when I switch it on, and then after a moment it just carries on and boots up normally. Everything works fine once I'm in, I just, you know, wanted to check whether that's something I should be dealing with.

Hi, um, thanks for picking up. So I've got a Contoso Vela Mini and the problem is that whenever I push it a bit, like exporting a video or having a lot of things open, the bottom of it gets really, really hot, and then after a while it just switches itself off completely. No warning, just black. It's okay for light stuff like browsing. The thing is, I'm teaching an online class this evening and I need to run the screen sharing and the recording at the same time, so I kind of need it to hold up today. What can we try?
你好，打扰了，我想申请一份你们公司保存的关于我的全部个人信息，包括我这台Contoso Vela Mini上传的所有遥测和使用数据，完整的副本。按照法规要求你们必须在15个工作日内答复，我真的很担心超了期限没人理，所以想问清楚具体要怎么提交、找谁跟进？麻烦尽快回我一下。

hi, my Contoso Titan G7 gets really hot when I'm gaming or compiling and then just powers off on its own
happens maybe 20 min into anything heavy, light use is fine
what do I need to check?

喂，你好，我这台Contoso AuraBook Pro 16的那些AI功能，就是实时字幕、背景虚化，还有那个Contoso AI助手，从昨天开始全都不行了，要么点了没反应，要么转半天圈然后提示超时。我重启了好几次也没用啊。关键是我今天下午三点要跟海外的客户开视频会，我英语不太好，全靠那个实时字幕，背景虚化也得开，不然家里乱七八糟的全露出来了。你们这功能到底怎么回事，赶紧给我弄好，别让我下午开会丢人。

Hi, yes, I'm calling about my Contoso AuraBook Pro 16. So last night I had it plugged in charging on my desk like I always do, and after about an hour there was this, um, this nasty burning smell, like hot plastic, and when I looked over there was actually a little wisp of smoke coming out from around the charging port side. I pulled the plug straight away. Honestly, I'm pretty annoyed, this isn't some cheap no-name machine, and I shouldn't be smelling smoke from it while it's just sitting there charging. So what are you going to do about it?
